The '''Desolation Station transport''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vessel used by [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]] to transport components of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] to it's construction site. As the transport was delivering the [[tributary beam]], was infiltrated by the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X2]] during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mission to Desolation Station|raid]] on the [[Space station/Legends|Station]]. X2 used the attached Tributary Beam to destroy Desolation Station, severely delaying production [[Time/Legends|time]] for parts to the Death Star.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />

==Characteristics==
The craft was similar in shape to [[Star Destroyer (Nar Shaddaa)|certain]] Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|star destroyers]], matching the same engine configuration and overall shape. It was propelled by 4 engine units, 2 on each side of a small fin at the rear. There was also a hanger positioned near the bow of the ship, big enough to contain at least a few [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. The transport also appeared to have a [[Conning tower|command tower]] similar in shape to the [[Victory II-class frigate]].<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />

It was defended by 7 [[laser cannon]]s, with 6 of them being positioned on towers around the top of the transport. The final cannon was placed on a mount located at the center of the vessel. While the tributary beam was merely being transported by the ship, it could be fired from the transport's weapons control room.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />

==History==
[[File:ShCorridor.png|thumb|right|250px|The transport in a [[shield corridor]]]]
Near the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was used to transport parts between Desolation Station and the [[Despayre|construction site]] of the Death Star. It was most notable during the Mission to Desolation Station, where it was being used to transport the final component of the Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], the tributary beam. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] clone by the name of X2 was recruited by [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] to infiltrate the [[asteroid base]] and disable the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] corridor protecting the transport, before using the tributary beam to destroy the station. After fighting his way through the base, X2 eventually disabled the shield corridor, and stole a TIE fighter.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />

Assisted by Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], X2 eventually reached the transport and destroyed the [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] protecting the ship, before boarding it. The rebel agent then infiltrated the weapons control room and used the tributary beam to destroy Desolation Station, halting production time for Death Star components, at least for a short time. The Station's [[Desolation Station's commander|captain]] managed to survive the incident, but was executed by it's overseer and X2's brother, [[X1]].<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron" />
